method: Authenticate complete original source families and frozen queue; independently compare Shapely covers at every native centre; preserve selected whole-feature identity, source role, lineage, names and explicit exclusions. Native constructor independently checks the complete original ADM2 source family. ADM1 members have no selected owner identities and remain retained contextual competitors, never invented location owners.
source_scope_decision: The selected metadata affirmatively defines these targets as named subregion territories with identical 2016 original source IDs and names. Nine targets retain prior shared-display topology reconciliation. Its source method explicitly distinguishes display partition from sovereignty. This whole-feature source-relative restoration preserves those original records; generic display flags are not named territorial exclusions. Exact source competitors and accepted owner-zero still guard every requested key. Restore supported original source components, including detached components, subject to physical support, competing owners and exact owner-zero. No component-current-overlap predicate is added.
limits: 2016 subregion-source relative restoration; no contemporary legal-jurisdiction certification.
FIN ADM1/ADM2 retain OSM/Wambacher ODbL 1.0; SWE ADM1 retains Erik Frohne / geoBoundaries CC BY 3.0.
Existing regional semantic review and historical-import gates remain open.
Complete original physical/native qualification and current selected consumer verification are subsequent stages.
